rule: New taxonomy-written items are numbered within their taxonomy in the order they were written; the odd-numbered ones (first, third, fifth...) are confirmatory. The original 28 items and the underspecified_request family are development-only: the first have been iterated against for four prompt-set versions, and the second have no mechanical grading contract to hold a confirmatory endpoint to.
why: A held-out set that can be redrawn is not held out. This file is the commitment; tests/test_eval_corpus.py fails if the confirmatory membership changes, so growing the set after seeing a result requires editing this file in a diff someone can see.
